description: Search the capital budget's §254 supporting detail (the "capital book": OMB's list of the Council's changes to the executive capital budget, Parts I and II), FY2018–FY2020 and FY2022–FY2027, from the checked tables BetaNYC reads from the PDFs. Each project row gives its ID, budget line, borough, agency, title, sponsor and the four printed year amounts as printed, with its status label, flags, review decision where decided, and three links. Filter by fiscal_year, project_id (substring: 'CC0001' finds 'HO CC0001'), budget_line (exact, e.g. 'P D018'), sponsor, borough (code), agency, title (also searches FY2019's descriptions), part, min_amount / max_amount (the book's own year). Rows in book order. The total is Part I's (it ties to the book's printed total), with "of which … went to non-city groups" from Part II; rows printed only in Part II are listed apart and never added. Reductions (negative amounts) are counted on their own. A sponsor printed "CD nn" is a district with no member. For the Council's own capital lists, use search_council_capital. Needs the optional PDF tables download. Text filters ignore case and accents; a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words only ('AI' finds 'AI-powered', not 'AIDS'), a longer one matches anywhere; whole_word true or false overrides that.

borough.description: Borough code as printed, any case: K, M, Q, R, X; 'A' and 'C' also match the rows that print them (not boroughs, meaning unclear; issue #227)

budget_line.description: Budget line, exact, agency code then line ('P D018', 'PW-DN846')

fiscal_year.description: The book's fiscal year: FY2018–FY2020 or FY2022–FY2027 (FY2021 is not checked yet)

limit.description: Max rows shown, 1–500 (default 50; above 500 is capped at 500, below 1 is an error). Totals always cover every match.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount in the book's own year column, dollars (inclusive)

min_amount.description: Minimum amount in the book's own year column, dollars (inclusive; reductions are negative)

part.description: The book's part: I, the projects (the total), or II, the non-city groups' list

project_id.description: Project ID as the book prints it (substring, case-insensitive, always: an identifier, so whole_word and the short-term rule do not apply; 'CC1' finds 'AG CC1053'): 'HO CC0001', or 'CC0001' without the agency code

sponsor.description: Sponsor as printed (substring), e.g. 'Speaker', 'Avilés'. 'CD 22' is a district with no member

whole_word.description: Sets how name and prose filters match: true, whole words only ('AI' not in 'Jamaica', 'Fellow' not in 'Fellowship'); false, anywhere ('AI' in 'AIDS'). Omit for the default: a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words, a longer one anywhere.

name: search_capital_book
title: Search the capital book (§254)
